create_ToStackedTensor: create a ToStackedTensor instance to convert a list of numpy arrays or PIL images to a stacked PyTorch tensor
use_ToStackedTensor_call: use the ToStackedTensor callable to transform a clip of images into a normalized tensor of shape m*C x H x W
convert_numpy_clip_to_tensor: convert a list of H x W x C numpy arrays in range [0,255] to a normalized torch.FloatTensor in range [0,1.0]
convert_pil_clip_to_tensor: convert a list of PIL Image objects to a stacked and normalized PyTorch tensor with channels interleaved per frame
review_ToStackedTensor_channel_nb: review the ToStackedTensor class and its channel_nb parameter which defaults to 3 for RGB image processing
